statements.t: “We delivered against our revenue expectation and exceeded our operating income outlook,” said Kevin Plank, Under Armour President and CEO.
The company expects the plan to be substantially complete by December 31, 2026.
The company has updated its fiscal 2027 outlook to reflect additional external cost pressures and planned inventory actions.

• Gross Margin is now expected to increase 170 to 220 basis points versus the prior expectation of a 220 to 270 basis point improvement due largely to higher fuel and freight costs, impacts of planned inventory management actions, and foreign exchange headwinds.

Excluding this benefit, the company continues to expect gross margin expansion driven by pricing actions, lower discounting, and a more favorable channel and product mix, partially offset by increased supply chain headwinds related to the ongoing conflict in the Middle East and unfavorable foreign exchange impacts.

Excluding transformation expenses and the reversal of the litigation reserve accrual, adjusted SG&A is still expected to decrease at a low-single-digit rate, reflecting actions to align operating expenses with the current demand environment while continuing to prioritize the company's highest-return strategic investments.

Interest income (expense), net includes interest income earned on our cash and cash equivalents and restricted investments, amortization of deferred financing costs, bank fees, capitalized interest for long-term property and equipment projects and interest expense under the credit and other long-term debt facilities.
The decrease in our effective tax rate was primarily driven by period over period changes in actual and forecasted pre-tax earnings and the reduced impact of global minimum taxes.

We will also pay a commitment fee determined in accordance with the pricing grid on the average daily unused amount of the revolving credit facility and certain fees with respect to letters of credit.
